Completion evidence for merged fix:

- Gerrit change 3007 revision `f4b72dc1f75a6740154c6f52e6367bf2c56cc1fe` earned both `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; revision-scoped submit returned MERGED.
- Merged commit on `origin/main`: `e84e4c5e9439bcfd27875d152de36eb40eb4f46b` (`Refresh mirror reachability main tip`).
- Live Mirror Guard evidence: GitHub Actions run `35507233659`, `headSha=e84e4c5e9439bcfd27875d152de36eb40eb4f46b`, `status=completed`, `conclusion=success`; observed after waiting 917 seconds for a qualifying post-merge scheduled run.
- Targeted merged-tree pytest evidence from archived tree with pinned `PYTHONPATH`: `38 passed in 1.34s` for `tests/unit/test_mirror_guard.py -q`.
- Ratchet evidence from the archived merged tree: complexity check printed `active=32 new=0 increased=0 stale=17`; mechanism check exited 0 and printed `active=682 new=26 increased=0 stale=0`, with the same admitted entries as the parent, so this change introduced no unadmitted mechanism entries.
- Full local `make verify` was intentionally not run on this macOS arm64 host: `pypandoc-binary==1.17`'s arm64 wheel ships an x86_64 pandoc, causing 17 unrelated pandoc tests to fail. Prior combined-stack local evidence on a worktree cherry-picking this fix onto `origin/main` plus 2 unrelated commits returned exactly the known host baseline: `17 failed, 20262 passed, 126 skipped, 21 warnings in 1701.85s`.
